evidence: Matches 'Windows' and 'Build system' labels; updates CMakeLists.txt, CMakePresets.json, and Windows CI scripts to switch native Windows builds from MSVC to clang-cl.
rationale: Migrates native Windows compilation and CI from MSVC to clang-cl, resolving persistent maintenance friction from MSVC internal compiler errors and reducing CI build times. The description notes this addresses issues like #31456 and unblocks dropping MSVC workarounds and enabling inline assembly optimizations on Windows.
